avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer reduces codeine metabolism and effectiveness; increases serotonin syndrome risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consult prescriber before discontinuing if currently taking

avoid_supplements.name: Valerian Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; increased sedation and respiratory depression risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use with codeine; use alternative sleep aids only under medical supervision

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Significant additive CNS depression; hepatotoxicity risk combined with codeine metabolism

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase codeine levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased opioid effects; use in moderation or space dosing

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate opioid effects and constipation
caution_supplements.action: Use standard doses; monitor bowel function and pain control

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases codeine plasma concentrations and opioid effects
avoid_foods.action: Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice during codeine therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slow codeine absorption and delay onset of analgesia
caution_foods.action: Take on empty stomach when possible; consistent timing with food acceptable

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: Additive CNS depression; increased sedation and respiratory depression risk
caution_foods.action: Limit or avoid alcohol; educate on potentiated side effects

monitoring_notes: Monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and constipation, especially in CYP2D6 poor metabolizers. Codeine efficacy depends on conversion to morphine via CYP2D6; interactions affecting this pathway significantly impact clinical response.
